violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. PIC was not able to provide Certified Food Manager certification.
violations.corrective_action: Please obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program before follow-up inspection. A follow-up inspection will be conducted within 10 days.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: In the 1DR upright refrigerator, the following foods were observed out of temperature: cut cabbage (48f), sliced cheese (49f), and string cheese (49f)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. KITCHEN STAFF DISCARDED THE FOODS.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 1DR upright refrigerator was observed at 46f
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO SERVICE THE REFRIGERATOR. REFRIGERATORS WORK BEST WHEN SET TO 32f-38f. ENSURE THE DOOR IS FIRMLY CLOSED IN BETWEEN USE. DO NOT KEEP TCS ITEMS (ie: cheese, sliced turkey, non-shelf stable milk, etc.) IN THIS REFRIGERATOR UNTIL IT IS REPAIRED.
